gloss: to laugh heartily; to roar with laughter

definitions.gloss: to laugh heartily; to roar with laughter; to laugh boldly
definitions.explanation: To laugh in a big, bold, uninhibited way. Implies a spirited, generous personality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}った。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}った。
examples.english: The company president heard the joke and laughed heartily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}う⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だった。
examples.english: My grandfather was the kind of person who would roar with laughter while telling old stories.

notes:
A common expression that pairs the na-adjective ⟦{豪快|ごうかい}→豪快：14228_goukai⟧ (bold, hearty) with ⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to laugh). The combination evokes a warm, open, unrestrained laugh — often associated with older men or people with big personalities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{豪快|ごうかい}→豪快：14228_goukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{笑|わら}い{飛|と}ばす: to laugh something off boldly
- ⟦{豪快|ごうかい}→豪快：14228_goukai⟧な⟦{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}→笑い声：24414_waraigoe⟧: a hearty laugh (as a sound)
- ⟦{豪快|ごうかい}→豪快：14228_goukai⟧な⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧: a bold laugh

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大笑|おおわら}い→大笑い：15938_oowarai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to laugh loudly — emphasizes volume
- ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}する→爆笑する：26846_bakushousuru⟧: to burst out laughing — more sudden, often in response to comedy
- {豪快|ごうかい}に{笑|わら}う suggests a personality trait more than a single reaction; the laughter is characteristically bold and unguarded
